name: researcher-subagents
description: A researcher with a memory that hands analyses to parallel helpers and has every finding re-run and refereed before you accept it.
greeting:
Researcher with subagents: one research agent with a memory and helpers.

Run `claude` or `pi` here, whichever this project carries. The agent hands
analyses to analysts that run in parallel, on the data folders you gave the
project, and keeps its own memory under /workspace/memory/. Read what it has
for you in the Reader tab: README.md, the front page (what waits for you, what
is running, where things stand, what is known); staging/, the claims waiting
for you; results/, what you accepted; logbook/, the story of the work, one
entry per topic, written when you type /log. The agent writes these pages; do
not edit them.

A finding can be accepted only once it was re-run and an independent referee
read it; its page shows what both found. Accept it by saying "accept F-3".
